messages:
jess_support: Hey @customer_john — sorry you're hitting this. Can you paste the exact redirect URI and the Google error string? :thinking:

customer_john: Using Android app with custom scheme myapp://auth/callback. Flow: Chrome custom tab -> google consent -> https://our-proxy.example.com/redirect?state=...&code=... -> proxy rewrites to myapp://auth/callback?state=...&code=... . Intermittent token exchange fails with error=invalid_grant.

jess_support: Any pattern by device or region? Any CDN/proxy in front?

customer_john: Mostly Android 11/12, ~5% users. We have CloudFront + Lambda@Edge doing rewrite. Server logs show Google returns invalid_grant (Bad Request) at token exchange.

devops-bot: trace: request_id=ff12a3 state_orig="AQIDw+X..." state_after_rewrite="AQIDw X..." (plus->space) path=/redirect

nina_mobile: Repro locally: if '+' becomes space in state, PKCE/state mismatch during token exchange. Reproduced with adb opening the deeplink where '+' turned into space.

sam_engineer: Sounds like URL normalization at edge or CDN converting '+' to ' '. If state is base64 (contains '+'), that will break. Are you using base64url?

customer_john: Ah — we do: state = crypto.randomBytes(16).toString('base64') and verifier = base64url(...). So state is standard base64 (has +).

ingrid_idp: Google expects exact state. If query arrives with spaces instead of '+', session lookup fails and token exchange yields invalid_grant.

sam_engineer: Mitigations: 1) client: switch state -> base64url or percent-encode '+' as %2B when building redirect. 2) infra: stop decoding/normalizing query when rewriting; preserve raw query string in Lambda.

jess_support: Customer should patch client ASAP; infra will investigate CloudFront/Lambda. @ingrid_idp @sam_engineer can you open a ticket?

ingrid_idp: Opening INF-2026 to audit rewrite logic and update docs recommending base64url for state+verifier.

deploy-bot: INF-2026 created, assignee=sam_engineer, priority=P2, ETA=48h

customer_john: Pushing client change to base64url state now. Will report back in 24h. Can't force immediate update for all users so infra fix still needed.

jess_support: Marking monitoring. If failures persist after client update we'll need specific request_id traces. :thumbsup:

customer_john: Update: new build deployed. After 6h failures down from ~5% to ~0.1%. Looks resolved for now.

jess_support: Great — closing after infra follow-up. Thanks everyone!
